name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 1996 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 1996 record supports: the 27 CERT/CC advisories CA-96.01 to CA-96.27 (UDP packet storms, phf and CGI interpreters, Java applets, the set-uid local root advisories, SYN flooding and the oversized ping), the Harvard intruder complaint, the Omega Engineering sabotage record, the BerkshireNet case, the year's web defacements and the Virus Bulletin record of Hare, Laroux and the macro viruses. No 1996 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_1996.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
